header: Contentious litigation in tax and administrative matters
text:
An effective corporate strategy must include an analysis of the legal and tax implications of transactions, enabling companies to make business decisions supported by the necessary legal framework and to mount a forceful tax defense before the appropriate authorities.

To this end, our experienced legal team offers the analysis, development, and implementation of defense strategies against administrative, provisional, or final rulings—including payable tax assessments. Today, it is essential to involve your advisors from the very start of any audit or verification process to ensure a coherent and comprehensive defense.
